steps.npc: That depends, what have you got?

steps.player: I'm sure I could knock you up a decent salad.
Oh, but your name suggests that-

steps.npc: I think you'll find I didn't name myself, you humans and your silly puns.

steps.player: No need to PUNish us for our incredible wit.

steps.npc: These old things? I guess they've dried up... I'm getting old and I need caring for. I've chosen you to do that by the way.

steps.player: Oh fantastic! I spend all that time training the Farming skill, and now I'm supposed to care for your herbs as well?

steps.npc: I could try the next person if you'd prefer?

steps.player: I'm just joking you old swine!
So you live in a hole? I would've thought Boars are surface dwelling mammals.

steps.npc: Well, I'm special! I bore down a little so I'm nice and cosy with my herbs exposed to the sun, it's all very interesting.

steps.player: Tell me... do you like Avacado?

steps.npc: I'm an insectivore, but even if I wasn't I'd hate Avacado!
I don't know why people like it so much... it tastes a like a ball of chewed up grass.

steps.player: Sometimes you can be such a bore...

steps.npc: When I was a young HERBIBOAR!!

steps.player: I'm standing right next to you, no need to shout...

steps.npc: I was trying to sing you a song...

using-items-on-herbi-butterflies-in-jars.npc: I've never been able to catch one, they've always eluded me.

using-items-on-herbi-butterflies-in-jars.text: Herbi chomps excitedly on the butterfly, he seems pleased.

using-items-on-herbi-butterflies-in-jars.npc: Woah! You should try those, they're amazing.

using-items-on-herbi-grubs-la-mode.text: Herbi munches happily on the grubs. It's rather gross.

using-items-on-herbi-king-worms-or-red-v.npc: I assume you mean worms, not sure I could stomach a wyrm, far too big.

using-items-on-herbi-king-worms-or-red-v.player: Oh yeah, those words don't even sound the same.

using-items-on-herbi-king-worms-or-red-v.npc: I don't judge you, now hand over those worms!

using-items-on-herbi-king-worms-or-red-v.text: Herbi hungrily devours the worms, you regret watching him do it.

using-items-on-herbi-spider-carcass.player: I got you a spider carcass!

using-items-on-herbi-spider-carcass.npc: Not really an insect, but admittedly I'm not too fussy.

using-items-on-herbi-spider-carcass.text: Herbi gobbles the spider down, several legs fall to the ground around him.

overhead-dialogue-battling-another-pet-o.npc: I'll show you a bacon salad!
